requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL expose the ontology OM relation, computed property, and class operation model through RelationDef, RelationLink, ComputedProp, and Operation vocabulary without legacy compatibility aliases.

case.when: current OM schema tables are created, snapshotted, diffed, and queried
case.then: system SHALL use `om_relation_def`, `om_relation_desc`, `om_relation_link`, `om_alias_relation`, `om_computed_prop_def`, `om_operation_def`, and `om_perm_operation` for the active storage contract

case.given: application code consumes `CozoOm` public APIs and DTOs
case.when: relation links, computed props, operations, and permission operations are defined or executed
case.then: system SHALL expose RelationDef, RelationLink, ComputedProp, and Operation vocabulary and SHALL NOT expose legacy relation/computed/operation compatibility APIs
